findings: Every selected image must be a complete bounded thin arm64 iOS Simulator image; foreign/fat architecture or malformed load tables fail rather than being skipped.

Consumer proof begins at the declared executable and follows only its exact strong debug-library edge; an unused decoy cannot qualify. Each matching target load must be unique within its image, strong and exactly the required @rpath identity.

Framework identity and actual embedded consumer loads are read from unchanged file descriptors, with owned file identities, complete prefix and file hashes. This reader neither edits nor executes binary bytes.

Signed retention binds the actual successful strict codesign command and both stream hashes. Framework and consumer provenance correctly name this same genuine producer; the adapter grants no additional process-group drain proof.

Existing archive function and its dependencies are unchanged. Signed bytes and modes are preserved before boot and uploaded separately as runtime-unqualified data; failed binary-load gating may still precede that retention point.
Failure capture adds only advertised stdout/stderr destinations to the exact original launch and takes one bounded read-only attributed snapshot. Missing reports remain inconclusive.
The nested guard now preserves the original launch/observation error even when diagnostic capture and its error recorder both fail. Original nonce/resource validation remains unchanged.
Single-install timeout300 uses the previously reviewed budget, with actual642-file,500,498,107-byte consumer evidence recorded separately; no retry or success inference is added.
Hidden-file upload flags repair transport of the two manifested resource members; no original source, package pin, facade or application target is replaced.
